lines.text: Pots of honey have even turned up in ancient Egyptian tombs, thousands of years old.
Here's the trick. Honey is only about seventeen percent water. Germs need water, and honey's sugar pulls it right out of them.

lines.text: It's also acidic, so most germs can't grow in it.
And bees even add an enzyme that helps fight germs.
